title: The Obstacle is the Path: Light of Christ and Growth through Problems
summary: Praising the rapid language and spiritual growth of the missionaries during interviews, President Hughes connects their radiant countenances to the Light of Christ, referencing Abraham Lincoln and Moroni 7. He shares a parable of a king who blocks a road with a boulder to teach his people that 'the obstacle in the path becomes the path,' encouraging missionaries to see quarantine challenges as opportunities to discover personal strength and divine solutions.
